name: How long does a storm damage repainting project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a storm damage repainting project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a storm damage repainting project varies based on the extent of the damage, the size of the property, and weather conditions. Minor repairs on small areas might take a few days, while extensive damage requiring significant surface preparation and a full exterior repaint could take one to two weeks, or even longer. Your contractor should provide a realistic timeline after a thorough assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on damage extent, property size, and weather. It can range from a few days for minor repairs to several weeks for full repaints.
